library(tidyverse)
library(brms)

# What this notebook does

The PCA (`4_PCA_featureDimensions`) is descriptive and **unsupervised** — it never sees
`groupID`, so modelling its *scores* by group is not circular (unlike modelling an LD
score, which was built from the labels).

We fit **one model per component with neutral cell-means coding** (`0 + groupID`)
and pull every comparison of interest **after the fit with `emmeans`**. Two reasons:

We  run the whole pipeline **twice**: `basis = "pca"` (unrotated) and
`basis = "varimax"` (rotated). Rotation is not relabelling — RC1 is a different axis from
PC1 — so scores, loadings, and component names all switch to the RC basis together.

Comparisons extracted (all in SD units, net of speaker & item):

- **gesture vs sign** — `conventionalization` (Gesture vs the three signing conditions) and,
  narrowly, `gesture_vs_native` (Gesture vs Sign).
- **learner1 – learner2 – signer progression** — `naive_vs_beginner` (L1 vs L2,
  within-subject), `beginner_vs_native` (L2 vs Sign), and a `progression_linear` /
  `progression_quad` trend across the three stages.

---

# 1. Config & helpers

```{r config}
group_levels <- c("Gesture", "Learner_1", "Learner_2", "Sign")

# ---- comparisons: weights in group_levels order (Gesture, Learner_1, Learner_2, Sign) ----
# fractional weights => each estimate is a directly interpretable mean difference in SD units.
comparisons <- list(
  # "gesture vs sign"
  conventionalization = c( -1, 1/3, 1/3, 1/3),  # Gesture - mean(L1, L2, Sign)
  gesture_vs_native   = c( -1,    0,    0,   1),   # Gesture - Sign  (narrow reading)
  # "learner1 - learner2 - signer" progression
  naive_vs_beginner   = c( 0,    -1,   1,    0),   # L1 - L2  (within-subject)
  learner_vs_native = c(0, -1/2, -1/2, 1),
  beginner_vs_native  = c( 0,    0,    -1,   1)   # L2 - Sign # THIS SHOULD MAYBE BE (mean L1;L2 vs sign)
)

pr <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = "b"),      # group means (cell-means coding)
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma")
)
```

```{r helpers}
# --- read one domain's score file, prefix component columns with the domain ---
# handles both PC (unrotated) and RC (varimax) component names
read_scores <- function(basis, domain) {
  suf  <- if (basis == "varimax") "_varimax" else ""
  path <- file.path("Datasets", sprintf("pca_scores_%s%s.csv", domain, suf))
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(domain, "_", .x), matches("^(PC|RC)[0-9]+$"))
}

# --- build the modelling frame for a basis: merge all/gross/fine, factor, z-score ---
build_d <- function(basis) {
  blocks <- map(c("all", "gross", "fine"), ~ read_scores(basis, .x))
  if (any(map_lgl(blocks, is.null))) return(NULL)   # a domain file missing -> skip basis
  names(blocks) <- c("all", "gross", "fine")

  comp_cols <- unlist(map(names(blocks), function(dm)
    grep(sprintf("^%s_(PC|RC)[0-9]+$", dm), names(blocks[[dm]]), value = TRUE)))

  key <- c("participant", "groupID", "concept")
  d <- reduce(blocks, full_join, by = key)

  d <- d %>%
    mutate(groupID     = factor(groupID, levels = group_levels),
           participant = factor(participant),
           concept     = factor(concept)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(comp_cols), ~ as.numeric(scale(.)), .names = "{.col}_z"))

  # NA report from the full joins (tokens not shared across all/gross/fine)
  na_rows <- d %>% summarise(across(all_of(comp_cols), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "component", values_to = "n_NA") %>%
    filter(n_NA > 0)
  if (nrow(na_rows)) { message("NA scores after join (", basis, "):"); print(na_rows) }

  stopifnot(all(levels(d$groupID) == group_levels))
  list(d = d, comp_cols = comp_cols)
}

# --- fit gaussian model for one component, cached per basis+component ---
fit_component <- function(comp, d, basis) {
  form <- bf(as.formula(paste0(comp, "_z ~ 0 + groupID + (1|participant) + (1|concept)")))
  brm(form, data = d, prior = pr, family = gaussian(),
      chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, seed = 1,
      control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
      file = file.path("models", paste0("brm_", basis, "_", comp)),
      file_refit = "on_change")
}

# --- extract all comparisons for one fit via emmeans (population-level: re_formula = NA) ---
extract_comparisons <- function(fit, comp, basis) {
  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ groupID, re_formula = NA)     # 4 marginal means, net of RE
  con <- contrast(emm, method = comparisons)          # weights positional in group order
  gather_emmeans_draws(con) %>%
    group_by(contrast) %>%
    summarise(estimate = median(.value),
              .lower   = quantile(.value, 0.025),
              .upper   = quantile(.value, 0.975),
              pd       = max(mean(.value > 0), mean(.value < 0)),
              .groups  = "drop") %>%
    mutate(component = comp,
           basis     = basis,
           domain    = str_extract(comp, "^(all|gross|fine)"),
           credible  = sign(.lower) == sign(.upper))
}

# --- convergence diagnostics for one fit ---
diagnose <- function(fit) {
  np  <- brms::nuts_params(fit)
  drw <- as_draws_df(fit)
  ess <- summarise_draws(drw, "ess_bulk", "ess_tail")
  tibble(max_rhat     = max(brms::rhat(fit), na.rm = TRUE),
         min_ess_bulk = min(ess$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
         min_ess_tail = min(ess$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE),
         n_divergent  = sum(np$Value[np$Parameter == "divergent__"]))
}

# --- read + tidy loadings for a basis (PC or RC id column -> prefixed `component`) ---
read_loadings <- function(basis, domain) {
  suf  <- if (basis == "varimax") "_varimax" else ""
  path <- file.path("Datasets", sprintf("loadings_%s%s.csv", domain, suf))
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  x  <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  id <- if (basis == "varimax") "RC" else "PC"
  if (!"sig_loading" %in% names(x) && "CI_above_null_after" %in% names(x))
    x <- rename(x, sig_loading = CI_above_null_after)     # tolerate the older column name
  x %>%
    rename(comp_id = all_of(id)) %>%
    mutate(comp_id   = as.character(comp_id),
           comp_id   = if_else(str_detect(comp_id, "^[0-9]+$"), paste0(id, comp_id), comp_id),
           component = paste0(domain, "_", comp_id),
           basis     = basis)
}
```

# 2. Modeling gesture vs learner vs native

```{r run-basis}
run_basis <- function(basis) {
  bd <- build_d(basis)
  if (is.null(bd)) { message("Skipping basis '", basis, "': score files missing."); return(NULL) }
  d <- bd$d; comp_cols <- bd$comp_cols
  message("[", basis, "] modelling: ", paste(comp_cols, collapse = ", "))

  fits <- setNames(lapply(comp_cols, fit_component, d = d, basis = basis), comp_cols)

  list(
    basis     = basis,
    d         = d,
    fits      = fits,
    comp_cols = comp_cols,
    coefs     = map_dfr(comp_cols, ~ extract_comparisons(fits[[.x]], .x, basis)),
    converge  = imap_dfr(fits, ~ mutate(diagnose(.x), component = .y, basis = basis)),
    n_part    = d %>% distinct(groupID, participant) %>% count(groupID, name = "n_participants")
  )
}


```

```{r}

load_or_run <- function(basis, cache_dir = "models", refit = FALSE) {
  f <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0("run_", basis, ".rds"))
  if (!refit && file.exists(f)) {
    message("[", basis, "] loading cached run")
    return(readRDS(f))
  }
  res <- run_basis(basis)
  if (!is.null(res)) {                       # don't cache a skipped basis
    dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    saveRDS(res, f)
  }
  res
}

res_pca     <- load_or_run("pca")
res_varimax <- load_or_run("varimax")        # re-attempts each run until files exist

runs   <- compact(list(res_pca, res_varimax))
coefs  <- map_dfr(runs, "coefs")
conv   <- map_dfr(runs, "converge")
```

## Convergence (all models, both bases)

```{r converge-table}
conv %>%
  mutate(flag = max_rhat > 1.01 | min_ess_bulk < 400 | n_divergent > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(flag), desc(max_rhat)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

Any `flag = TRUE` needs attention (bump `adapt_delta`/`iter`, or a heavier-tailed family —
see §7).

## Comparison estimates per component

```{r coef-table}
coefs %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, .lower, .upper, pd), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  arrange(basis, domain, component, contrast)
```

`estimate` is a mean difference in SD units; `pd` is the posterior probability of direction;
`credible` = 95% CrI excludes 0. 

## Domain × comparison: which dimension carries which comparison

```{r domain-comparison-plot, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 6}
library(tidytext)
library(ggh4x)

coefs %>%
  mutate(idx       = as.integer(str_extract(component, "[0-9]+$")),
         component = fct_reorder(component, idx, .desc = TRUE)) %>%   # PC1/RC1 top -> PC5/RC5 bottom
  ggplot(aes(estimate, component, colour = credible)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = .lower, xmax = .upper)) +
  facet_grid(basis + domain ~ contrast, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#C44E52", `FALSE` = "grey65"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "effect (SD units, net of speaker)", y = NULL,
       title = "Domain × comparison, unrotated vs rotated") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

```

library(tidyverse)

## Model checks

```{r pp-loo, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4}
# posterior predictive + LOO for every fit; collect Pareto-k warnings
loo_tab <- imap_dfr(runs, function(run, i) {
  imap_dfr(run$fits, function(fit, comp) {
    l <- loo(fit)
    tibble(basis = run$basis, component = comp,
           elpd_loo   = l$estimates["elpd_loo", "Estimate"],
           p_loo      = l$estimates["p_loo", "Estimate"],
           n_pareto_k_gt_0.7 = sum(l$diagnostics$pareto_k > 0.7))
  })
})
loo_tab %>% arrange(desc(n_pareto_k_gt_0.7)) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 1)))

pp_check(res_pca$fits[[ res_pca$comp_cols[1] ]], ndraws = 100)
```

## Interpretation — which features drive each credible comparison

Join credible comparisons to the (basis-matched) significant loadings. Direction: a positive
comparison estimate on a positively-loading feature => the first group shows *more* of it.

```{r interpretation}

loadings <- map_dfr(
  c("pca", "varimax"),
  function(b) map_dfr(c("all", "gross", "fine"), ~ read_loadings(b, .x))
)

interpretation <- coefs %>%
  filter(credible) %>%
  select(basis, component, contrast, effect = estimate) %>%
  inner_join(loadings, by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
  filter(sig_loading) %>%
  mutate(
    # keep full `feature`; also split leading category from the measure name
    category = if_else(str_detect(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+__"),
                       str_extract(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+"),   # e.g. "gross__rwrist"
                       NA_character_),
    measure  = if_else(str_detect(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+__"),
                       str_remove(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+__"),  # e.g. "speed_mean"
                       variable),
    moves    = if_else(sign(effect) == sign(loading_sign), "↑ more", "↓ less")
  ) %>%
  arrange(basis, contrast, component, category, desc(abs(loading))) %>%
  relocate(category, measure, .after = component)

interpretation
```
